module_summary: 2-bit ripple-carry adder built from two chained add1 full-adder instances, carry passed through Co_temp from bit 0 to bit 1.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: 2-bit sum output assembled from the two add1 instance outputs.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: 2-bit operand A, bit-sliced into the two full adders.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: 2-bit operand B, bit-sliced into the two full adders.

anchors.name: Co
anchors.why: Final carry-out from the upper add1 instance, chains to next adder stage.

anchors.name: Cin
anchors.why: Carry-in feeding the low-bit full adder.

anchors.name: Co_temp
anchors.why: Internal ripple carry from bit-0 adder into bit-1 adder.

groups.name: ripple_carry_adder
groups.description: Two add1 full adders chained by Co_temp forming a 2-bit ripple-carry adder.
